bio: Arthur C. Brooks is the Parker Gilbert Montgomery Professor of the Practice of Public Leadership at the Harvard Kennedy School, and Professor of Management Practice at the Harvard Business School, where he teaches courses on leadership, happiness, and nonprofit management. He is also a CBS News Contributor, columnist with The Free Press, and host of the weekly podcast "Office Hours with Arthur Brooks."
